001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import java.util.Collection;
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.Locale;
011import java.util.Map;
012import java.util.Objects;
013import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
014import java.util.function.Function;
015import java.util.stream.Stream;
016
017import org.jspecify.annotations.NonNull;
018import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
019
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LevelResolver.LevelConfig;
021
022/**
023 * Resolves levels from logger names.
024 *
025 * @apiNote {@linkplain Level#ALL} is considered to be equivalent to null or unspecified.
026 */
027public interface LevelResolver {
028
029        /**
030         * Determines what level the logger should be at. {@linkplain Level#ALL} is to signal
031         * that nothing was resolved.
032         * @param name logger name.
033         * @return resolved level or {@link Level#ALL} if unable to resolve.
034         */
035        public Level resolveLevel(String name);
036
037        /**
038         * Convenience method that checks if the loggers resolved level is less than the
039         * passed in level.
040         * @param loggerName logger name.
041         * @param level level.
042         * @return true if logger is less than passed in level.
043         */
044        default boolean isEnabled(String loggerName, Level level) {
045                return checkEnabled(level, resolveLevel(loggerName));
046        }
047
048        /**
049         * Clears any caching of levels.
050         */
051        default void clear() {
052
053        }
054
055        /**
056         * A special resolver that has direct mappings of logger name to level via
057         * {@link #levelOrNull(String)}.
058         */
059        @FunctionalInterface
060        interface LevelConfig extends LevelResolver {
061
062                /**
063                 * Returns a level exactly matching a logger name.
064                 * @param name logger name.
065                 * @return level or <code>null</code>.
066                 */
067                @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name);
068
069                /**
070                 * The default level if no level is found. By default if not overridden this is
071                 * calculated by calling {@link #levelOrNull(String)} with an empty String and if
072                 * it returns <code>null</code> ALL is returned.
073                 * @return level
074                 */
075                default Level defaultLevel() {
076                        var root = levelOrNull("");
077                        if (root == null) {
078                                return Level.ALL;
079                        }
080                        return root;
081                }
082
083                /**
084                 * Resolves a level by walking up the dotted path by calling
085                 * {@link #levelOrNull(String)} which follows <a href=
086                 * "https://logback.qos.ch/manual/architecture.html#effectiveLevel">Logbacks
087                 * Effective Level</a>. {@inheritDoc}
088                 */
089                @Override
090                default Level resolveLevel(String name) {
091                        return resolveLevel(this, name);
092                }
093
094                /**
095                 * Creates a level config from a list of level configs.
096                 * @param config configs.
097                 * @return coalesced config.
098                 */
099                public static LevelConfig of(Collection<? extends LevelConfig> config) {
100                        if (config.isEmpty()) {
101                                return StaticLevelResolver.OFF;
102                        }
103                        else if (config.size() == 1) {
104                                return Objects.requireNonNull(config.iterator().next());
105                        }
106                        return new CompositeLevelConfig(config.stream().flatMap(c -> {
107                                if (c instanceof CompositeLevelConfig cc) {
108                                        return Stream.of(cc.levelConfigs());
109                                }
110                                return Stream.of(c);
111                        }).distinct().toList().toArray(new LevelConfig[] {}));
112                }
113
114                private static Level resolveLevel(LevelConfig levelBindings, String name) {
115                        Function<String, @Nullable Level> f = s -> allToNull(levelBindings.levelOrNull(s));
116                        var level = LogProperties.findUpPathOrNull(name, f);
117                        if (level != null) {
118                                return level;
119                        }
120                        return levelBindings.defaultLevel();
121                }
122
123                private static @Nullable Level allToNull(@Nullable Level level) {
124                        if (level == null || level == Level.ALL) {
125                                return null;
126                        }
127                        return level;
128                }
129
130        }
131
132        /**
133         * Level resolver builder.
134         * @return builder.
135         */
136        public static Builder builder() {
137                return new Builder();
138        }
139
140        /**
141         * A level resolver that is off.
142         * @return level resolver that is {@link Level#OFF}.
143         */
144        public static LevelResolver off() {
145                return StaticLevelResolver.OFF;
146        }
147
148        /**
149         * Statically checks if requested level is greater than or equal to the logger level
150         * based on LevelResolver rules.
151         * <p>
152         * Rules are:
153         * <ol>
154         * <li><code>OFF</code> for either level or logger level is <code>false</code></li>
155         * <li><code>ALL</code> is converted to <code>TRACE</code> for both level and
156         * loggerLevel</li>
157         * </ol>
158         * @param level if OFF will always return false.
159         * @param loggerLevel if OFF will always return false.
160         * @return true if level is greater or equal to loggerLevel unless either is OFF.
161         * @apiNote this method is mainly used for testing purposes and is not designed with
162         * performance in mind. In facades it is better to get an integer and use that for
163         * comparison.
164         */
165        public static boolean checkEnabled(System.Logger.Level level, System.Logger.Level loggerLevel) {
166                if (level == System.Logger.Level.OFF) {
167                        return false;
168                }
169                if (loggerLevel == System.Logger.Level.OFF) {
170                        return false;
171                }
172                level = normalizeLevel(level);
173                loggerLevel = normalizeLevel(loggerLevel);
174                return level.getSeverity() >= loggerLevel.getSeverity();
175        }
176
177        /**
178         * Parses a Level from a string. ALL is converted to TRACE.
179         * @param input level like String where case is ignored and SLF4J and JUL level names
180         * are supported as well.
181         * @return level
182         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the input is not recognized as a level.
183         */
184        public static Level parseLevel(String input) throws IllegalArgumentException {
185                input = input.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
186                return switch (input) {
187                        case "ALL" -> Level.TRACE;
188                        case "TRACE", "FINEST" -> Level.TRACE;
189                        case "DEBUG", "FINE" -> Level.DEBUG;
190                        case "INFO" -> Level.INFO;
191                        case "WARN", "WARNING" -> Level.WARNING;
192                        case "ERROR", "SEVERE" -> Level.ERROR;
193                        case "OFF" -> Level.OFF;
194                        default -> {
195                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot parse Level from input. input='" + input + "'");
196                        }
197                };
198        }
199
200        /**
201         * Will convert ALL to TRACE.
202         * @param level level
203         * @return a Level.
204         */
205        public static Level normalizeLevel(Level level) {
206                return Builder.allToTrace(level);
207        }
208
209        /**
210         * Abstract level resolver builder.
211         *
212         * @param <T> builder type.
213         * @apiNote while this builder class is public it is effectively package protected per
214         * the constructor on purpose. It is public to allow Javadoc to propagate correctly.
215         */
216        abstract class AbstractBuilder<T> {
217
218                /**
219                 * level configs.
220                 */
221                protected List<LevelConfig> levelConfigs = new ArrayList<>();
222
223                /**
224                 * levels
225                 */
226                protected Map<String, Level> levels = new LinkedHashMap<>();
227
228                /**
229                 * Do nothing constructor.
230                 */
231                AbstractBuilder() {
232                }
233
234                /**
235                 * Sets a logger to a level.
236                 * @param level level.
237                 * @param loggerName logger name.
238                 * @return this builder.
239                 */
240                public T level(Level level, String loggerName) {
241                        levels.put(loggerName, level);
242                        return self();
243                }
244
245                /**
246                 * Sets a level for all loggers.
247                 * @param level level.
248                 * @return this builder.
249                 */
250                public T level(Level level) {
251                        levels.put("", level);
252                        return self();
253                }
254
255                /**
256                 * Adds a level config.
257                 * @param resolver level config.
258                 * @return this builder.
259                 */
260                public T config(LevelConfig resolver) {
261                        levelConfigs.add(resolver);
262                        return self();
263                }
264
265                /**
266                 * Adds a level config based on properties and will use the prefix as the root.
267                 * @param properties properties containing levels with prefix.
268                 * @param prefix for example <code>logging.level</code>
269                 * @return this.
270                 */
271                public T config(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
272                        config(ConfigLevelResolver.of(properties, prefix));
273                        return config(GroupLevelResolver.of(properties, prefix));
274                }
275
276                /**
277                 * Builds the level config based on {@link #levelConfigs} and {@link #levels}.
278                 * @return level config or <code>null</code>.
279                 */
280                protected @Nullable LevelConfig buildLevelConfigOrNull() {
281                        var copyLevels = new LinkedHashMap<>(levels);
282                        var copyResolvers = new ArrayList<>(levelConfigs);
283                        if (copyLevels.isEmpty() && copyResolvers.isEmpty()) {
284                                return null;
285                        }
286                        if (!copyLevels.isEmpty()) {
287                                copyResolvers.add(0, Builder.ofStaticMap(copyLevels));
288                        }
289                        var combined = LevelConfig.of(copyResolvers);
290                        return combined;
291                }
292
293                /**
294                 * This.
295                 * @return this.
296                 */
297                protected abstract T self();
298
299        }
300
301        /**
302         * Level resolver builder. {@link LevelConfig} that are added have higher precedence.
303         */
304        public final class Builder extends AbstractBuilder<Builder> {
305
306                /**
307                 * level resolvers.
308                 */
309                private final List<LevelResolver> levelResolvers = new ArrayList<>();
310
311                /**
312                 * lower priority fallback resolvers.
313                 */
314                private final List<LevelResolver> fallbacks = new ArrayList<>();
315
316                private Builder() {
317                }
318
319                /**
320                 * Builds a level resolver combining {@link #config(LevelConfig)},
321                 * {@link #level(Level, String)}, and {@link #resolver(LevelResolver)} into a
322                 * single resolver of equal priority (the highest severity/most restrictive level
323                 * found for a logger name wins), and, if any {@link #fallback(LevelResolver)
324                 * fallbacks} were added, wrapping that in a priority chain where the fallbacks
325                 * are only consulted for logger names the combined resolver above has no opinion
326                 * on (resolves to {@link Level#ALL}). The result is cached - deferred as a
327                 * {@link LogProvider} (rather than building the cached resolver directly) since
328                 * the cache also needs {@link LogConfig#alerts()} to report a logger name whose
329                 * level property fails to resolve, and only a couple of resolver primitives (this
330                 * builder's cache, and separately the global resolver's own alerting wrapper)
331                 * need alerts at all - not every {@link LevelResolver}/{@link LevelConfig}
332                 * implementation.
333                 * @return level resolver provider.
334                 */
335                public LogProvider<LevelResolver> build() {
336                        var config = buildLevelConfigOrNull();
337                        List<LevelResolver> copy = new ArrayList<>();
338                        if (config != null) {
339                                copy.add(config);
340                        }
341                        copy.addAll(levelResolvers);
342                        LevelResolver resolver = ofResolvers(copy);
343                        if (!fallbacks.isEmpty()) {
344                                List<LevelResolver> priority = new ArrayList<>();
345                                priority.add(resolver);
346                                priority.addAll(fallbacks);
347                                resolver = PriorityLevelResolver.of(priority);
348                        }
349                        var _resolver = resolver;
350                        return (name, c) -> cached(_resolver, c.alerts());
351                }
352
353                /**
354                 * Adds a level resolver to the end of the resolve list. Resolvers added this way
355                 * are combined with equal priority: for a given logger name the most restrictive
356                 * level found across all of them (including {@link #config(LevelConfig)} /
357                 * {@link #level(Level, String)}) wins.
358                 * @param resolver level resolver.
359                 * @return this
360                 */
361                public Builder resolver(LevelResolver resolver) {
362                        this.levelResolvers.add(resolver);
363                        return this;
364                }
365
366                /**
367                 * Adds a lower priority fallback level resolver. Fallbacks are tried in the order
368                 * added and only consulted for a logger name if every resolver ahead of it
369                 * (everything from {@link #config(LevelConfig)}, {@link #level(Level, String)},
370                 * {@link #resolver(LevelResolver)}, and any earlier added fallback) has no
371                 * opinion for that name, i.e. resolves to {@link Level#ALL}. This is useful for
372                 * e.g. giving a route's own level configuration priority over a global level
373                 * resolver without a more specific match in the global resolver being able to
374                 * win.
375                 * @param resolver fallback level resolver.
376                 * @return this
377                 */
378                public Builder fallback(LevelResolver resolver) {
379                        this.fallbacks.add(resolver);
380                        return this;
381                }
382
383                /**
384                 * This.
385                 * @return this.
386                 */
387                @Override
388                protected Builder self() {
389                        return this;
390                }
391
392                static LevelResolver ofResolvers(Collection<? extends LevelResolver> resolvers) {
393                        if (resolvers.isEmpty()) {
394                                return StaticLevelResolver.ALL;
395                        }
396                        else if (resolvers.size() == 1) {
397                                return Objects.requireNonNull(resolvers.iterator().next());
398                        }
399                        return CompositeLevelResolver.of(resolvers);
400                }
401
402                static LevelConfig ofStaticMap(Map<String, Level> levels) {
403                        if (levels.isEmpty()) {
404                                return StaticLevelResolver.ALL;
405                        }
406                        else if (levels.size() == 1) {
407                                var e = levels.entrySet().iterator().next();
408                                if (e.getKey().equals("")) {
409                                        return StaticLevelResolver.of(e.getValue());
410                                }
411                                return new SingleLevelResolver(e.getKey(), allToTrace(e.getValue()));
412                        }
413                        Map<String, Level> copy = new HashMap<>();
414
415                        for (var et : levels.entrySet()) {
416                                copy.put(et.getKey(), allToTrace(et.getValue()));
417                        }
418                        return new MapLevelResolver(copy);
419                }
420
421                static Level allToTrace(Level level) {
422                        if (level == Level.ALL) {
423                                return Level.TRACE;
424                        }
425                        return level;
426                }
427
428                static LevelResolver cached(LevelResolver resolver, LogAlerts alerts) {
429                        if (resolver instanceof StaticLevelResolver) {
430                                return resolver;
431                        }
432                        return new CachedLevelResolver(resolver, alerts);
433                }
434
435        }
436
437}
438
439enum StaticLevelResolver implements LevelConfig {
440
441        ALL(Level.ALL), //
442        TRACE(Level.TRACE), //
443        INFO(Level.INFO), //
444        DEBUG(Level.DEBUG), //
445        ERROR(Level.ERROR), //
446        WARNING(Level.WARNING), //
447        OFF(Level.OFF),; //
448
449        private final Level level;
450
451        private StaticLevelResolver(Level level) {
452                this.level = level;
453        }
454
455        static LevelConfig of(Level level) {
456                return switch (level) {
457                        case INFO -> StaticLevelResolver.INFO;
458                        case ALL -> StaticLevelResolver.TRACE; // This is on purpose
459                        case DEBUG -> StaticLevelResolver.DEBUG;
460                        case ERROR -> StaticLevelResolver.ERROR;
461                        case OFF -> StaticLevelResolver.OFF;
462                        case TRACE -> StaticLevelResolver.TRACE;
463                        case WARNING -> StaticLevelResolver.WARNING;
464                };
465        }
466
467        @Override
468        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
469                if ("".equals(name)) {
470                        return this.level;
471                }
472                return null;
473        }
474
475        @Override
476        public Level resolveLevel(String name) {
477                return this.level;
478        }
479
480}
481
482record SingleLevelResolver(String name, Level level) implements LevelConfig {
483
484        @Override
485        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
486                if (this.name.equals(name)) {
487                        return this.level;
488                }
489                return null;
490        }
491
492}
493
494record MapLevelResolver(Map<String, Level> levels) implements LevelConfig {
495        @Override
496        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
497                return levels.get(name);
498        }
499}
500
501@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent")
502record CompositeLevelConfig(LevelConfig[] levelConfigs) implements LevelConfig {
503
504        @Override
505        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
506                for (var c : levelConfigs) {
507                        var level = c.levelOrNull(name);
508                        if (level != null) {
509                                return level;
510                        }
511                }
512                return null;
513        }
514
515        @Override
516        public String toString() {
517                return this.getClass().getSimpleName() + Arrays.asList(levelConfigs);
518        }
519
520}
521
522@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent")
523record CompositeLevelResolver(LevelResolver[] resolvers, Level defaultLevel) implements LevelResolver {
524
525        public static LevelResolver of(Collection<? extends LevelResolver> resolvers) {
526                List<LevelResolver> resolved = new ArrayList<>();
527
528                for (var r : resolvers) {
529                        if (r instanceof CompositeLevelResolver cr) {
530                                for (var j : cr.resolvers()) {
531                                        resolved.add(j);
532                                }
533                        }
534                        else {
535                                resolved.add(r);
536                        }
537                }
538                @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
539                LevelResolver @NonNull [] array = resolved.toArray(new LevelResolver[] {});
540                return new CompositeLevelResolver(array, Level.OFF);
541        }
542
543        @Override
544        public String toString() {
545                return this.getClass().getSimpleName() + Arrays.asList(resolvers);
546        }
547
548        @Override
549        public Level resolveLevel(String name) {
550                Level current = Level.ALL;
551                for (var resolver : resolvers) {
552                        var level = resolver.resolveLevel(name);
553                        if (level == Level.TRACE) {
554                                return level;
555                        }
556                        if (current == Level.ALL) {
557                                current = level;
558                                continue;
559                        }
560                        if (current.getSeverity() > level.getSeverity()) {
561                                current = level;
562                        }
563                }
564                if (current == Level.ALL) {
565                        current = defaultLevel;
566                }
567                return current;
568        }
569
570        @Override
571        public void clear() {
572                for (var resolver : resolvers) {
573                        resolver.clear();
574                }
575        }
576
577}
578
579/*
580 * Revisit perf. ConcurrentHashMap based on benchmarks is incredibly slow for most cases
581 * and looping can be faster.
582 *
583 * Luckily level resolution is only called when a logger is created and the loggers are
584 * cached.
585 */
586/*
587 * Resolves against resolvers in order and returns the first non ALL result. This gives
588 * earlier resolvers priority per logger name rather than merging all resolvers into one
589 * combined prefix walk, where a more specific match in a lower priority resolver could
590 * otherwise win over a coarser match in a higher priority one regardless of which is
591 * meant to take precedence.
592 */
593@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent")
594record PriorityLevelResolver(LevelResolver[] resolvers) implements LevelResolver {
595
596        public static LevelResolver of(Collection<? extends LevelResolver> resolvers) {
597                List<LevelResolver> resolved = new ArrayList<>();
598                for (var r : resolvers) {
599                        if (r instanceof PriorityLevelResolver pr) {
600                                for (var j : pr.resolvers()) {
601                                        resolved.add(j);
602                                }
603                        }
604                        else {
605                                resolved.add(r);
606                        }
607                }
608                if (resolved.isEmpty()) {
609                        return StaticLevelResolver.ALL;
610                }
611                if (resolved.size() == 1) {
612                        return resolved.get(0);
613                }
614                @SuppressWarnings("null") // TODO eclipse bug
615                LevelResolver @NonNull [] array = resolved.toArray(new LevelResolver[] {});
616                return new PriorityLevelResolver(array);
617        }
618
619        @Override
620        public Level resolveLevel(String name) {
621                for (var resolver : resolvers) {
622                        var level = resolver.resolveLevel(name);
623                        if (level != Level.ALL) {
624                                return level;
625                        }
626                }
627                return Level.ALL;
628        }
629
630        @Override
631        public void clear() {
632                for (var resolver : resolvers) {
633                        resolver.clear();
634                }
635        }
636
637        @Override
638        public String toString() {
639                return this.getClass().getSimpleName() + Arrays.asList(resolvers);
640        }
641
642}
643
644final class CachedLevelResolver implements LevelResolver {
645
646        private final LevelResolver levelResolver;
647
648        private final LogAlerts alerts;
649
650        private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Level> levelCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
651
652        public CachedLevelResolver(LevelResolver levelResolver, LogAlerts alerts) {
653                super();
654                this.levelResolver = levelResolver;
655                this.alerts = alerts;
656        }
657
658        @Override
659        public Level resolveLevel(String name) {
660                return levelCache.computeIfAbsent(name, n -> {
661                        try {
662                                return levelResolver.resolveLevel(n);
663                        }
664                        catch (Exception e) {
665                                /*
666                                 * A malformed level property must not be able to break logging itself.
667                                 * ConcurrentHashMap#computeIfAbsent leaves nothing cached when the
668                                 * mapping function throws, so without catching here a bad property would
669                                 * re-parse and re-throw on every single resolveLevel(n) call for this
670                                 * logger name, not just once - a real amplification risk for a hot
671                                 * logger. Fall back to a fixed, conservative default (Level.INFO,
672                                 * matching LogProperties' own documented root default) and alert exactly
673                                 * once per logger name instead, since the fallback value is itself cached
674                                 * above just like a successful resolution would be.
675                                 */
676                                alerts.error(CachedLevelResolver.class,
677                                                "Failed to resolve level for logger '" + n + "', falling back to " + Level.INFO, e);
678                                return Level.INFO;
679                        }
680                });
681        }
682
683        @Override
684        public String toString() {
685                return this.getClass().getSimpleName() + "[" + levelResolver + "]";
686        }
687
688        @Override
689        public void clear() {
690                levelCache.clear();
691                levelResolver.clear();
692        }
693
694}
695
696/**
697 * Wraps the global {@link LevelConfig} (see
698 * {@code LogConfig.Builder.buildGlobalResolver}) with the same
699 * alert-on-failure/fallback-to-INFO safety net as {@link CachedLevelResolver} gives every
700 * per-route resolver, but implemented at the {@link #levelOrNull(String)} level (not
701 * {@link #resolveLevel(String)}) so {@link LevelConfig#defaultLevel()} stays available -
702 * {@code LogConfig.levelResolver()} is declared to return {@link LevelConfig}, not just
703 * {@link LevelResolver}, and real callers use {@code defaultLevel()}. Unlike
704 * {@link CachedLevelResolver} this does not cache successful lookups (the global resolver
705 * never has), only failed ones, purely so a bad property alerts once per logger name
706 * instead of on every call.
707 * <p>
708 * Special-cased outside the normal {@code LevelResolver.Builder.build()} ->
709 * {@code LogProvider<LevelResolver>} path since the global resolver is built before a
710 * {@link LogConfig} exists to pull {@link LogAlerts} from - see where this is constructed
711 * for why {@link LogAlerts} (and {@link LogMetrics}, via alerts' own listener wiring) are
712 * built and handed in directly instead.
713 */
714final class AlertingLevelConfig implements LevelConfig {
715
716        private final LevelConfig levelConfig;
717
718        private final LogAlerts alerts;
719
720        private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Level> failedNames = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
721
722        AlertingLevelConfig(LevelConfig levelConfig, LogAlerts alerts) {
723                this.levelConfig = levelConfig;
724                this.alerts = alerts;
725        }
726
727        @Override
728        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
729                var fallback = failedNames.get(name);
730                if (fallback != null) {
731                        return fallback;
732                }
733                try {
734                        return levelConfig.levelOrNull(name);
735                }
736                catch (Exception e) {
737                        alerts.error(AlertingLevelConfig.class,
738                                        "Failed to resolve level for logger '" + name + "', falling back to " + Level.INFO, e);
739                        failedNames.putIfAbsent(name, Level.INFO);
740                        return Level.INFO;
741                }
742        }
743
744        @Override
745        public void clear() {
746                failedNames.clear();
747                levelConfig.clear();
748        }
749
750        @Override
751        public String toString() {
752                return "AlertingLevelConfig[" + levelConfig + "]";
753        }
754
755}
756
757final class GroupLevelResolver implements LevelConfig {
758
759        private final LogProperties properties;
760
761        private final String groupLevelPrefix;
762
763        private volatile LevelConfig levelResolver;
764
765        public static GroupLevelResolver of(LogProperties properties) {
766                return new GroupLevelResolver(properties, LogProperties.LEVEL_PREFIX);
767        }
768
769        public static GroupLevelResolver of(LogProperties properties, String groupLevelPrefix) {
770                return new GroupLevelResolver(properties, groupLevelPrefix);
771        }
772
773        GroupLevelResolver(LogProperties properties, String groupLevelPrefix) {
774                super();
775                this.properties = properties;
776                this.groupLevelPrefix = groupLevelPrefix;
777                this.levelResolver = populate(properties, this.groupLevelPrefix);
778        }
779
780        static final String GROUPS_PROPERTY = LogProperties.GROUPS_PROPERTY;
781        static final String GROUP_PROPERTY = LogProperties.GROUP_PROPERTY;
782
783        @Override
784        public Level resolveLevel(String name) {
785                return levelResolver.resolveLevel(name);
786        }
787
788        @Override
789        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
790                return levelResolver.levelOrNull(name);
791        }
792
793        @Override
794        public void clear() {
795                this.levelResolver = populate(properties, this.groupLevelPrefix);
796        }
797
798        static LevelConfig populate(LogProperties properties, String groupLevelPrefix) {
799
800                Map<String, List<String>> groupToLoggers = properties.forKey(GROUPS_PROPERTY).ofList().map(_groups -> {
801                        Map<String, List<String>> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
802                        for (String g : _groups) {
803                                rawValue(properties.forKey(GROUP_PROPERTY, g).ofList()).optional()
804                                        .filter(loggers -> !loggers.isEmpty())
805                                        .ifPresent(loggers -> m.put(g, loggers));
806                        }
807                        return m;
808                }).or(Map.of()).validateNow(GroupLevelResolver.class);
809
810                Map<String, Level> groupToLevels = new LinkedHashMap<>();
811                for (var e : groupToLoggers.entrySet()) {
812                        String group = e.getKey();
813                        rawValue(properties.forKey(LogProperties.concatKey(groupLevelPrefix, group))
814                                .ofString()
815                                .map(LevelResolver::parseLevel)).optional().ifPresent(level -> groupToLevels.put(group, level));
816                }
817                Map<String, Level> loggerToLevels = new LinkedHashMap<>();
818                for (var e : groupToLevels.entrySet()) {
819                        /*
820                         * groupToLevels's keys are always a subset of groupToLoggers's own keys
821                         * (built by iterating groupToLoggers.entrySet() above), whose values are
822                         * already guaranteed non-empty by the filter() when groupToLoggers was
823                         * populated - so this lookup can never actually be null or empty.
824                         */
825                        List<String> loggers = Objects.requireNonNull(groupToLoggers.get(e.getKey()));
826                        for (var logger : loggers) {
827                                loggerToLevels.put(logger, e.getValue());
828                        }
829                }
830                return new MapLevelResolver(Map.copyOf(loggerToLevels));
831        }
832
833        /*
834         * Both group-loggers and group-level lookups above are optional (a Missing group or
835         * group-level entry is fine, just skipped) but must still surface a present-but
836         * malformed value's raw, unwrapped exception - not a "Validation failed for
837         * GroupLevelResolver:" wrapping, which would also change the exception's public type
838         * away from PropertyConvertException. LogProperty.Result no longer exposes
839         * optional()/value() itself (a bare Result might still be Missing), so this just
840         * narrows to LogProperty.ValidatedResult - true for every concrete Result, Missing
841         * included - without going through a Validator at all.
842         */
843        private static <T> LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> rawValue(LogProperty.Result<T> result) {
844                return switch (result) {
845                        case LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> vr -> vr;
846                };
847        }
848
849        @Override
850        public String toString() {
851                return "GroupLevelResolver[groupLevelPrefix=" + groupLevelPrefix + ", properties=" + properties + "]";
852        }
853
854}
855
856final class ConfigLevelResolver implements LevelConfig {
857
858        private final LogProperties properties;
859
860        private final String prefix;
861
862        public static ConfigLevelResolver of(LogProperties properties) {
863                return of(properties, LogProperties.LEVEL_PREFIX);
864        }
865
866        public static ConfigLevelResolver of(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
867                return new ConfigLevelResolver(properties, prefix);
868        }
869
870        private ConfigLevelResolver(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
871                super();
872                this.properties = properties;
873                this.prefix = prefix;
874        }
875
876        @Override
877        public @Nullable Level levelOrNull(String name) {
878                return rawValue(
879                                properties.forKey(LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, name)).ofString().map(LevelResolver::parseLevel))
880                        .valueOrNull();
881        }
882
883        /*
884         * Same rationale as GroupLevelResolver's own rawValue(): optional (a Missing level
885         * override is fine), but a present-but-malformed value must still surface its raw,
886         * unwrapped PropertyConvertException rather than a Validator-wrapped one.
887         */
888        private static <T> LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> rawValue(LogProperty.Result<T> result) {
889                return switch (result) {
890                        case LogProperty.ValidatedResult<T> vr -> vr;
891                };
892        }
893
894        @Override
895        public String toString() {
896                return "ConfigLevelResolver[prefix=" + prefix + ", properties=" + properties + "]";
897        }
898
899}
